Scheme: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi (Demo) (IN-CEN-001)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
Category: Agriculture
Target Beneficiaries: Farmers, Cultivable Landholding Agricultural Households
Eligible Occupations: Farmer
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Supported Benefits: Direct Income Support, Agricultural Input Assistance
Description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year transferred in three equal installments to eligible landholding farmer families.
Overview: A central sector demonstration summary illustrating direct income supplementation to small and marginal agricultural households to support input procurement and seasonal crop expenses.
Official Source: https://pmkisan.gov.in

Scheme: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi (Demo) — Eligibility, Restrictions & Exceptions
Target Beneficiaries: Farmers, Cultivable Landholding Agricultural Households
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Eligibility Conditions:
1. Cultivable landholding farmer families as recorded in state/UT land registries.
2. Applicant must be an Indian citizen aged 18 years or above.
3. Mandatory Aadhaar e-KYC and Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Important Restrictions & Exceptions:
1. Institutional landholders are excluded.
2. Former and present holders of constitutional posts, serving/retired government officers, and income tax payers in the last assessment year are excluded.
3. Professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers, and chartered accountants registered with professional bodies are excluded.
Summary Note: Requires cultivable agricultural landholding status in official records.
Structured Thresholds: minAge=18, maxAge=N/A, maxAnnualIncome=N/A, occupations=Farmer, genders=All, residence=All, states=All India, requiresBpl=No
Source Document(s): pmkisan-operational-guidelines-demo.txt | Official Website: https://pmkisan.gov.in

Scheme: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi (Demo) — Benefits, Documents & Application Procedure
Supported Benefits: Direct Income Support, Agricultural Input Assistance
Benefits:
1. ₹6,000 per year disbursed in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months.
2. Direct bank transfer via Aadhaar-linked Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
3. Helps cover seasonal seed, fertilizer, and domestic agricultural expenses.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Land Ownership Record / 7/12 Extract
3. Bank Passbook
4. Mobile Number linked with Aadhaar
Application Procedure:
Step 1: Verify land record entry and complete Aadhaar e-KYC.
Step 2: Submit farmer registration details through pmkisan.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Step 3: Track state-level verification and installment release status using registration ID.
Official Source: https://pmkisan.gov.in

Scheme: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Demo) (IN-CEN-002)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
Category: Healthcare
Target Beneficiaries: Vulnerable Households, BPL / SECC Families, Senior Citizens 70+
Eligible Occupations: All
Eligible Social Categories: BPL, SECC, EWS, SC, ST, OBC, All
Supported Benefits: Health Insurance, Cashless Hospitalization Coverage
Description: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year across empanelled hospitals.
Overview: Demonstration summary of India’s flagship public health assurance program providing cashless treatment coverage for eligible economically vulnerable households.
Official Source: https://pmjay.gov.in

Scheme: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Demo) — Eligibility, Restrictions & Exceptions
Target Beneficiaries: Vulnerable Households, BPL / SECC Families, Senior Citizens 70+
Eligible Social Categories: BPL, SECC, EWS, SC, ST, OBC, All
Eligibility Conditions:
1. Households listed under SECC deprivation categories or holding eligible state-linked ration/BPL cards.
2. No cap on family size or member age under scheme rules.
3. Senior citizens aged 70+ qualify under expanded senior citizen coverage.
Important Restrictions & Exceptions:
1. Covers inpatient hospitalization packages; routine OPD consultations without admission are generally excluded.
2. Cosmetic procedures and non-listed experimental treatments are excluded.
Summary Note: Primarily targeted at socio-economically eligible households or senior citizens.
Structured Thresholds: minAge=N/A, maxAge=N/A, maxAnnualIncome=250000, occupations=All, genders=All, residence=All, states=All India, requiresBpl=Yes
Source Document(s): nha-pmjay-summary-demo.txt | Official Website: https://pmjay.gov.in

Scheme: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Demo) — Benefits, Documents & Application Procedure
Supported Benefits: Health Insurance, Cashless Hospitalization Coverage
Benefits:
1. Health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
2. Covers pre-hospitalization diagnostics (3 days) and post-hospitalization follow-up (15 days).
3. Paperless and cashless access at empanelled public and private hospitals nationwide.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Ration Card
3. Income Certificate
4. Domicile Certificate
Application Procedure:
Step 1: Check family inclusion status via beneficiary.nha.gov.in.
Step 2: Visit nearest empanelled hospital Ayushman Mitra desk or CSC for Aadhaar e-KYC.
Step 3: Download Ayushman card upon verification for cashless admission.
Official Source: https://pmjay.gov.in

Scheme: National Post-Matric Scholarship (Demo) (IN-CEN-003)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Ministry of Education & Social Justice
Category: Education
Target Beneficiaries: Students, Post-Matric Scholars, Engineering & Degree Students, EWS / SC / ST / OBC / Minority Students
Eligible Occupations: Student
Eligible Social Categories: EWS, SC, ST, OBC, Minority, All
Supported Benefits: Scholarship, Tuition Fee Reimbursement, Academic Maintenance Allowance
Description: Tuition fee reimbursement and monthly academic maintenance allowance for students enrolled in post-matriculation studies.
Overview: Demonstration entry representing central scholarship assistance designed to reduce financial drop-out barriers for students pursuing Class 11, diploma, undergraduate, and postgraduate programs.
Official Source: https://scholarships.gov.in

Scheme: National Post-Matric Scholarship (Demo) — Eligibility, Restrictions & Exceptions
Target Beneficiaries: Students, Post-Matric Scholars, Engineering & Degree Students, EWS / SC / ST / OBC / Minority Students
Eligible Social Categories: EWS, SC, ST, OBC, Minority, All
Eligibility Conditions:
1. Student enrolled in a recognized post-matriculation or post-secondary institution.
2. Annual household income below ₹2,50,000 across all sources (varies by specific scholarship sub-scheme).
3. Minimum qualifying academic percentage and attendance compliance.
Important Restrictions & Exceptions:
1. Students cannot simultaneously avail two central post-matric scholarships for the same academic year.
2. Failure to maintain minimum attendance or passing promotion may halt renewal.
Summary Note: Requires active enrollment in a recognized post-matric course.
Structured Thresholds: minAge=15, maxAge=32, maxAnnualIncome=250000, occupations=Student, genders=All, residence=All, states=All India, requiresBpl=No
Source Document(s): nsp-guidelines-demo.txt | Official Website: https://scholarships.gov.in

Scheme: National Post-Matric Scholarship (Demo) — Benefits, Documents & Application Procedure
Supported Benefits: Scholarship, Tuition Fee Reimbursement, Academic Maintenance Allowance
Benefits:
1. Reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable institutional tuition fees.
2. Annual maintenance allowance for hostellers and day scholars.
3. Direct disbursement into the student’s Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Academic Marksheet
3. Income Certificate
4. Caste / Category Certificate
5. Bank Passbook
Application Procedure:
Step 1: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) and generate an OTR ID.
Step 2: Complete academic profile and upload scanned supporting certificates.
Step 3: Submit form for institute nodal verification and state/central sanction.
Official Source: https://scholarships.gov.in

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0 (Demo) (IN-CEN-004)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
Category: Housing
Target Beneficiaries: Urban Families, First-Time Homebuyers, EWS / LIG Households
Eligible Occupations: All
Eligible Social Categories: EWS, LIG, All
Supported Benefits: Housing Subsidy, Home Construction Grant, Interest Subsidy
Description: Interest subsidy and direct financial assistance for EWS and LIG urban families building or purchasing their first pucca home.
Overview: Demonstration summary illustrating urban affordable housing support through Beneficiary-Led Construction and Interest Subsidy components.
Official Source: https://pmaymis.gov.in

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0 (Demo) — Eligibility, Restrictions & Exceptions
Target Beneficiaries: Urban Families, First-Time Homebuyers, EWS / LIG Households
Eligible Social Categories: EWS, LIG, All
Eligibility Conditions:
1. Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
2. Annual household income up to ₹3,00,000 (EWS) or ₹6,00,000 (LIG).
3. Applicant must reside in a notified statutory town or urban local body area.
Important Restrictions & Exceptions:
1. Families who have already availed central/state housing assistance under prior housing missions are ineligible.
2. Property must be located within notified urban planning boundaries.
Summary Note: Applicant household must not already own a permanent (pucca) residence.
Structured Thresholds: minAge=21, maxAge=N/A, maxAnnualIncome=600000, occupations=All, genders=All, residence=Urban, states=All India, requiresBpl=No
Source Document(s): pmay-u-2-demo.txt | Official Website: https://pmaymis.gov.in

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0 (Demo) — Benefits, Documents & Application Procedure
Supported Benefits: Housing Subsidy, Home Construction Grant, Interest Subsidy
Benefits:
1. Interest subsidy or central construction grant up to ₹2.50 lakh for eligible urban households.
2. Promotes female co-ownership or sole ownership of assisted housing units.
3. Supports both new house construction and eligible home purchase.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Income Certificate
3. Domicile Certificate
4. Bank Passbook
5. PAN Card
Application Procedure:
Step 1: Review income bracket and check municipal urban local body eligibility.
Step 2: Submit online assessment via pmaymis.gov.in or municipal facilitation desk.
Step 3: Complete geo-tagged site or loan verification with participating bank/ULB.
Official Source: https://pmaymis.gov.in

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Demo) (IN-CEN-005)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Ministry of Finance
Category: Business & Entrepreneurship
Target Beneficiaries: Entrepreneurs, Small Business Owners, Artisans, Unemployed Youth Starting Business
Eligible Occupations: Self-Employed / MSME, Unemployed
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Supported Benefits: Collateral-Free Business Loan, Working Capital Credit
Description: Collateral-free micro-enterprise loans across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun tiers up to ₹20 lakh for non-farm small businesses.
Overview: Demonstration record outlining institutional credit access for micro-enterprises, artisans, shopkeepers, and small service providers through commercial banks and MFIs.
Official Source: https://www.mudra.org.in

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Demo) — Eligibility, Restrictions & Exceptions
Target Beneficiaries: Entrepreneurs, Small Business Owners, Artisans, Unemployed Youth Starting Business
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Eligibility Conditions:
1. Indian citizen aged 18+ with a viable non-farm income-generating business plan.
2. Clean credit history with no prior willful loan default.
3. Available to sole proprietors, partnership firms, and small service enterprises.
Important Restrictions & Exceptions:
1. Strictly intended for non-farm manufacturing, trading, and service micro-enterprises (direct crop farming loans are outside MUDRA).
2. Tarun Plus tier (₹10–20 lakh) applies to entrepreneurs who successfully repaid earlier Tarun loans.
Summary Note: Requires a non-farm micro or small business activity.
Structured Thresholds: minAge=18, maxAge=65, maxAnnualIncome=N/A, occupations=Self-Employed / MSME, Unemployed, genders=All, residence=All, states=All India, requiresBpl=No
Source Document(s): mudra-scheme-demo.txt | Official Website: https://www.mudra.org.in

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Demo) — Benefits, Documents & Application Procedure
Supported Benefits: Collateral-Free Business Loan, Working Capital Credit
Benefits:
1. Collateral-free term loans and working capital from ₹50,000 (Shishu) up to ₹20,00,000 (Tarun Plus).
2. No third-party collateral security required under Credit Guarantee framework.
3. Supports machinery purchase, inventory expansion, and small commercial operations.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. PAN Card
3. Bank Passbook
4. Business Registration / Udyam Certificate
Application Procedure:
Step 1: Prepare a concise business profile and projected cash flow summary.
Step 2: Apply via JanSamarth portal or approach nearest scheduled commercial bank / RRB.
Step 3: Complete KYC and credit appraisal for loan sanction.
Official Source: https://www.mudra.org.in

Scheme: DAY-NRLM Lakhpati Didi Initiative (Demo) (IN-CEN-006)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Ministry of Rural Development
Category: Women Empowerment
Target Beneficiaries: Rural Women, Self-Help Group (SHG) Members, Women Micro-Entrepreneurs
Eligible Occupations: All
Eligible Social Categories: All, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Supported Benefits: Livelihood Training, SHG Credit Support, Enterprise Startup Assistance
Description: Livelihood training, revolving credit, and market linkage support for rural women Self-Help Group (SHG) members.
Overview: Demonstration entry showcasing rural women enterprise enablement aimed at helping SHG households reach sustainable annual incomes above ₹1 lakh.
Official Source: https://aajeevika.gov.in

Scheme: DAY-NRLM Lakhpati Didi Initiative (Demo) — Eligibility, Restrictions & Exceptions
Target Beneficiaries: Rural Women, Self-Help Group (SHG) Members, Women Micro-Entrepreneurs
Eligible Social Categories: All, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Eligibility Conditions:
1. Women residing in rural areas who are active members of a recognized Self-Help Group.
2. Age generally between 18 and 55 years.
3. Household annual income below ₹3,00,000 in sample guidelines.
Important Restrictions & Exceptions:
1. Restricted to rural households organized within registered DAY-NRLM Self-Help Groups.
Summary Note: Designed for rural women participating in Self-Help Groups.
Structured Thresholds: minAge=18, maxAge=55, maxAnnualIncome=300000, occupations=All, genders=Female, residence=Rural, states=All India, requiresBpl=No
Source Document(s): day-nrlm-lakhpati-didi-demo.txt | Official Website: https://aajeevika.gov.in

Scheme: DAY-NRLM Lakhpati Didi Initiative (Demo) — Benefits, Documents & Application Procedure
Supported Benefits: Livelihood Training, SHG Credit Support, Enterprise Startup Assistance
Benefits:
1. Interest-subvented SHG working capital and enterprise startup support.
2. Hands-on vocational, financial literacy, and digital bookkeeping training.
3. Market access support for rural crafts, dairy, poultry, and agro-processing.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Bank Passbook
3. Domicile Certificate
4. SHG Membership Record
Application Procedure:
Step 1: Join or verify membership in a village-level Self-Help Group under SRLM.
Step 2: Submit a household livelihood plan through the Block Mission Management Unit.
Step 3: Access training and SHG credit disbursement upon cluster approval.
Official Source: https://aajeevika.gov.in

Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (Demo) (IN-CEN-007)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Ministry of Finance (PFRDA)
Category: Pension
Target Beneficiaries: Unorganized Sector Workers, Informal Workers, Non-Income-Tax Payers
Eligible Occupations: Unorganized Worker, Self-Employed / MSME, Farmer, Salaried
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Supported Benefits: Guaranteed Monthly Pension, Spouse Pension Security
Description: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60 based on regular subscriber contributions.
Overview: Demonstration overview of a voluntary contributory pension scheme focused on workers in the unorganized sector to secure predictable post-retirement income.
Official Source: https://www.npscra.nsdl.co.in

Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (Demo) — Eligibility, Restrictions & Exceptions
Target Beneficiaries: Unorganized Sector Workers, Informal Workers, Non-Income-Tax Payers
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Eligibility Conditions:
1. Indian citizen aged between 18 and 40 years.
2. Active savings bank account or post office savings account.
3. Subscriber must not be an income tax payer at enrollment.
Important Restrictions & Exceptions:
1. Income tax payers are ineligible to join APY.
2. Premature exit before age 60 is permitted only under exceptional circumstances.
Summary Note: Entry age window is strictly 18–40 years; excludes income tax payers.
Structured Thresholds: minAge=18, maxAge=40, maxAnnualIncome=N/A, occupations=Unorganized Worker, Self-Employed / MSME, Farmer, Salaried, genders=All, residence=All, states=All India, requiresBpl=No
Source Document(s): apy-pfrda-demo.txt | Official Website: https://www.npscra.nsdl.co.in

Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (Demo) — Benefits, Documents & Application Procedure
Supported Benefits: Guaranteed Monthly Pension, Spouse Pension Security
Benefits:
1. Guaranteed minimum monthly pension between ₹1,000 and ₹5,000 upon turning 60.
2. Spouse continues to receive the same pension after the subscriber’s lifetime.
3. Nominee receives accumulated corpus after both subscriber and spouse.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Bank Passbook
3. Mobile Number linked with Bank Account
Application Procedure:
Step 1: Visit your bank branch or enable enrollment through net-banking APY portal.
Step 2: Select desired pension slab (₹1,000 to ₹5,000) and auto-debit frequency.
Step 3: Receive Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) confirmation.
Official Source: https://www.npscra.nsdl.co.in

schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (Demo)
content:
Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (Demo) (IN-CEN-008)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Ministry of Rural Development
Category: Senior Citizens
Target Beneficiaries: Senior Citizens (60+), Elderly in BPL Households
Eligible Occupations: All
Eligible Social Categories: BPL, All
Supported Benefits: Monthly Old-Age Pension, Social Security Assistance
Description: Monthly non-contributory pension support for senior citizens aged 60 and above from BPL households.
Overview: Demonstration summary of social assistance under NSAP providing basic monthly financial security to elderly citizens in economically vulnerable households.
Official Source: https://nsap.nic.in

schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (Demo)
content:
Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (Demo) — Eligibility, Restrictions & Exceptions
Target Beneficiaries: Senior Citizens (60+), Elderly in BPL Households
Eligible Social Categories: BPL, All
Eligibility Conditions:
1. Citizen aged 60 years or older.
2. Household listed under Below Poverty Line (BPL) criteria prescribed by the state.
3. Not receiving overlapping statutory old-age pension benefits.
Important Restrictions & Exceptions:
1. Restricted strictly to BPL households as defined by state/central criteria.
Summary Note: Requires age 60+ and BPL eligibility verification.
Structured Thresholds: minAge=60, maxAge=N/A, maxAnnualIncome=150000, occupations=All, genders=All, residence=All, states=All India, requiresBpl=Yes
Source Document(s): nsap-ignoaps-demo.txt | Official Website: https://nsap.nic.in

schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (Demo)
content:
Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (Demo) — Benefits, Documents & Application Procedure
Supported Benefits: Monthly Old-Age Pension, Social Security Assistance
Benefits:
1. Central monthly pension component enhanced with state top-up grants (varies by state).
2. Higher pension slab automatically applicable for citizens aged 80 years and above.
3. Direct credit into senior citizen bank or post office account.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Senior Citizen Age Proof
3. Ration Card
4. Bank Passbook
5. Income Certificate
Application Procedure:
Step 1: Obtain age verification and BPL status verification from local Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body.
Step 2: Submit NSAP application through state social welfare office or UMANG portal.
Step 3: Receive monthly DBT credit upon district sanction.
Official Source: https://nsap.nic.in

Scheme: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (Demo) (IN-CEN-009)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
Category: Employment
Target Beneficiaries: Unemployed Youth, Graduates Seeking Skills, Students, School/College Dropouts
Eligible Occupations: Student, Unemployed, Unorganized Worker
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Supported Benefits: Free Vocational Skill Training, NSQF Certification, Placement & Apprenticeship Support
Description: Free industry-aligned vocational training, certification, and placement assistance for youth across technical and service trades.
Overview: Demonstration record describing short-term skill certification and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) programs aimed at improving youth employability.
Official Source: https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in

Scheme: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (Demo) — Eligibility, Restrictions & Exceptions
Target Beneficiaries: Unemployed Youth, Graduates Seeking Skills, Students, School/College Dropouts
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Eligibility Conditions:
1. Indian youth generally aged 15 to 45 years.
2. School/college dropouts or unemployed youth seeking industry-ready certification.
3. Valid Aadhaar and bank account for tracking assessment support.
Important Restrictions & Exceptions:
1. Candidates must fulfill minimum attendance requirements to qualify for final assessment certification.
Summary Note: Open to youth and workers seeking NSQF-aligned vocational skills.
Structured Thresholds: minAge=15, maxAge=45, maxAnnualIncome=N/A, occupations=Student, Unemployed, Unorganized Worker, genders=All, residence=All, states=All India, requiresBpl=No
Source Document(s): pmkvy4-demo.txt | Official Website: https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in

Scheme: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (Demo) — Benefits, Documents & Application Procedure
Supported Benefits: Free Vocational Skill Training, NSQF Certification, Placement & Apprenticeship Support
Benefits:
1. 100% tuition-free short-term skill training at accredited Skill India centers.
2. Nationally recognized NSQF certification upon assessment.
3. Placement support, apprenticeship linkage, and career counseling.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Academic Marksheet
3. Bank Passbook
Application Procedure:
Step 1: Browse accredited Skill India Digital Hub courses and select a trade.
Step 2: Enroll at a nearby Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK) with Aadhaar verification.
Step 3: Complete training hours and pass practical assessment for certification.
Official Source: https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in

Scheme: MGNREGA Rural Wage Guarantee (Demo) (IN-CEN-010)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Ministry of Rural Development
Category: Rural Development
Target Beneficiaries: Rural Households, Rural Wage Seekers, Agricultural Labourers
Eligible Occupations: Farmer, Unorganized Worker, Unemployed
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Supported Benefits: Guaranteed Wage Employment, Rural Livelihood Security
Description: Guarantees up to 100 days of unskilled manual wage employment per financial year to rural households.
Overview: Demonstration summary of statutory rural livelihood security focusing on durable community assets, water conservation, and rural connectivity.
Official Source: https://nrega.nic.in

Scheme: MGNREGA Rural Wage Guarantee (Demo) — Eligibility, Restrictions & Exceptions
Target Beneficiaries: Rural Households, Rural Wage Seekers, Agricultural Labourers
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Eligibility Conditions:
1. Adult members of any rural household willing to undertake unskilled manual work.
2. Applicant must be 18 years or older and reside in the respective Gram Panchayat.
Important Restrictions & Exceptions:
1. Applicable strictly to rural Gram Panchayat jurisdictions; urban municipal areas are excluded.
Summary Note: Exclusively applicable to rural Gram Panchayat residents.
Structured Thresholds: minAge=18, maxAge=N/A, maxAnnualIncome=N/A, occupations=Farmer, Unorganized Worker, Unemployed, genders=All, residence=Rural, states=All India, requiresBpl=No
Source Document(s): mgnrega-demo.txt | Official Website: https://nrega.nic.in

Scheme: MGNREGA Rural Wage Guarantee (Demo) — Benefits, Documents & Application Procedure
Supported Benefits: Guaranteed Wage Employment, Rural Livelihood Security
Benefits:
1. Up to 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per rural household annually.
2. Wages transferred directly to worker bank accounts within 15 days of muster roll closure.
3. Unemployment allowance provisions if work is not allotted within statutory window.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Domicile Certificate
3. Bank Passbook
4. Ration Card
Application Procedure:
Step 1: Apply for a Job Card at the local Gram Panchayat office.
Step 2: Submit written or digital demand for work once Job Card is issued.
Step 3: Report to allotted worksite and receive direct wage credit.
Official Source: https://nrega.nic.in

Scheme: PM SVANidhi Street Vendor Credit (Demo) (IN-CEN-011)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
Category: Financial Assistance
Target Beneficiaries: Urban Street Vendors, Hawkers, Small Urban Stall Operators
Eligible Occupations: Self-Employed / MSME, Unorganized Worker
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Supported Benefits: Working Capital Micro-Loan, Interest Subsidy, Digital Cashback
Description: Affordable working capital micro-loans starting at ₹10,000 with interest subsidy and digital cashback incentives for urban street vendors.
Overview: Demonstration summary of micro-credit restoration and digital payment onboarding for urban street vendors, hawkers, and small stall operators.
Official Source: https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in

Scheme: PM SVANidhi Street Vendor Credit (Demo) — Eligibility, Restrictions & Exceptions
Target Beneficiaries: Urban Street Vendors, Hawkers, Small Urban Stall Operators
Eligible Social Categories: All, General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST
Eligibility Conditions:
1. Urban street vendors holding Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body.
2. Age 18 years or older engaged in urban vending activities.
Important Restrictions & Exceptions:
1. Second and third loan tranches require timely full repayment of the previous tranche.
Summary Note: Requires urban street vendor verification.
Structured Thresholds: minAge=18, maxAge=N/A, maxAnnualIncome=N/A, occupations=Self-Employed / MSME, Unorganized Worker, genders=All, residence=Urban, states=All India, requiresBpl=No
Source Document(s): pm-svanidhi-demo.txt | Official Website: https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in

Scheme: PM SVANidhi Street Vendor Credit (Demo) — Benefits, Documents & Application Procedure
Supported Benefits: Working Capital Micro-Loan, Interest Subsidy, Digital Cashback
Benefits:
1. Progressive collateral-free working capital loans of ₹10,000, ₹20,000, and ₹50,000.
2. 7% annual interest subsidy on timely repayment.
3. Monthly digital transaction cashback incentives.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Bank Passbook
3. ULB Vending Certificate / LOR
Application Procedure:
Step 1: Verify vendor survey listing or request Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body.
Step 2: Submit loan application via pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre.
Step 3: Complete lender KYC to receive working capital disbursement.
Official Source: https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in

Scheme: ADIP & Divyangjan Assistance Scheme (Demo) (IN-CEN-012)
Verification Status: Demonstration (v1)
Government Level: Central (Central Government of India)
Department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
Category: Social Welfare
